chunks: And they ask you about Dhu al-Qarnain. Say, 'I will recite to you about him a mention.'

key_terms.ذِي الْقَرْنَيْنِ: Dhu al-Qarnain (The Two-Hornedged One or Possessor of Two Epochs)

ai.seo_question: Who is Dhu al-Qarnain and what does the Quran say about him?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the Quraysh's demand for a 'sign' to validate Muhammad's prophethood, with Dhu al-Qarnain serving as a historical precedent of a just ruler who upheld monotheism. The narrative not only answers their query but also establishes a paradigm of leadership grounded in divine justice and territorial expansion, resonating with the concept of the Mahdi's future global rule.
